notes.title: Post Next Fest Patch 1.07
notes.content:
Next Fest is a wrap!

It's no secret that Vitriol is VERY early in development - and Next Fest saw our largest player spike so far. The goal was to double our wishlists — but instead, we nearly tripled them.

With it came heaps of feedback and suggestions that I've been digging through. 

If you've played the demo at all, we’d love to hear from you — either leave a review on the demo, or join our Discord and let us know your thoughts!

Thanks for being part of the early journey.

BURN AND FALLOW.

---------------------
Shoutout to NinjaGuy VR for covering the project in his next fest overview!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oLdStYrDgVE
----------------------

PATCH NOTES:

NEW RETICLE METHOD - (Now For Individual Eyes)     
ADDED Weapon Bench TUTORIAL BUTTON

Added "Mag/Mod: Next Page" To all books
Level 2 Books Rewritten
Level 2 Out of Bounds & CheckPoint error, Fixed

Various Tiny lil level visual fixes

Hand has to be 1 meter away for 0.8 seconds to reset Instead of instantly(Fixes some recoil problems)

Level 4 Boss(Hound) now attacks instantly after spawning
Grapple Reticle No longer shows up if Not unlocked


Weapon Bench Visual Error & Slight changes to red text
Weapon Bench, added teleport triggers in grooves of the sliders
Exiting Weapon Bench disables secondary physics barrels
Grabbing Weapon Bench Drawers now change the screen & slider
Python Mag Swap Screw grab point & animations

Python shot radius & power now affected by damage
Increased Python Krait Magazine Recoil
Pentagon(Krait) QuickLoader Visual Error & Environmental Collisions
Python Krait, you can no longer shoot whilst spinning since you are holding down hammer button
Angular velocity is reset when grabing a spinning python
Python & Spin & Parry Tutorial Tweaks (Temporary, A larger Overhaul will be coming to better prepare new players before enemies spawn)
